document: Phase 8 premise-staleness scan, batches B through H
author: architecture-conformance-auditor
mode: READ-ONLY. No sprint artifact was written by this pass.
hunted_class: An issue whose body or acceptance criterion rests on a state claim that was true when written and is false now.
method: For every state claim found, the path was opened, the grep run, or the thing counted. No claim was accepted by reasoning about whether it was probably still true.

scope.verification: MEASURED by grouping github_issues.json by batch and cross-joining issue_key_map.json. The claimed split B2 C4 D3 E6 F3 G9 H2 sums to 29 and matches the file exactly.

evidence_labels.MEASURED: Checked against disk, git or a parser by this pass, now.
evidence_labels.CITED: Read from an artifact; not independently re-derived.
evidence_labels.INFERRED: Derived by reasoning over MEASURED inputs; derivation stated.

findings.what_it_blocks: Nothing mechanically -- the paragraph is advisory. But it sends an implementer of the highest-risk call-graph issue to three locations to fix a defect already fixed, and its presence implies the correction did not land when it did.

findings.claim_as_written: The design is a pinned build-time snapshot (ADR-007) of the routing registries plus only the personas for DISPATCHABLE agents -- not all 505 agent directories.

findings.claim_as_written: Eighteen file:line citations into the requirements and architecture documents, e.g. V2-030's 'recorded at SRS.md:808 as an explicit OUTSTANDING obligation' and V2-036's 'register-mcp is step 2 (hld_v2.md:1318) and the FR-23 reachability verification is step 3 (hld_v2.md:1319)'.
findings.what_is_actually_true_now: The cited documents grew after the issues were drafted, so the line numbers no longer resolve. MEASURED line counts at draft commit 7b29820 versus now: SRS.md 975 -> 1131 (+156), hld_v2.md 1946 -> 2023 (+77), hld.md 1946 -> 2023 (+77), prd-v2.md 507 -> 511 (+4), product-sequencing-v2.md 760 -> 760 (unchanged), REVIEW-INDEX.md 325 -> 325 (unchanged). 17 of the 18 citations point into a document that changed length. A sample of 16 was resolved line-by-line; 8 are confirmed wrong: SRS.md:296 and SRS.md:307 now land on BLANK LINES; SRS.md:808 lands on FR-11 verification prose while the OUTSTANDING Change Log obligation it names is now at SRS.md:968; SRS.md:749 lands on the FR-22 row; hld_v2.md:661 and :683 land on circuit-breaker and message-queue content unrelated to the ADR-017 CI assertion V2-025 cites them for; hld_v2.md:1318 and :1319 land on the NFR cross-interaction table while SS 10's migration runbook now begins at hld_v2.md:1342. The remaining 8 sampled citations still resolve to relevant content because they sit above the insertion points.
findings.what_it_blocks: Nothing hard. Each cited fact still exists somewhere in its document, so the substance survives; only the pointers rot. It costs an implementer a search, and two citations landing on blank lines read as a deleted section.
findings.probe_limitation: 16 of 18 citations were resolved individually; the other 2 were counted but not opened. The 8-confirmed-wrong figure is therefore a floor, not a total.

findings.claim_as_written: AC2: 'The reduced design's regression test asserts the per-turn spawn count is at most 2 (the two scripts confirmed to exist) unless a named exception is documented with a rationale.' The body of the same issue says: 'The true floor is approximately 2 -- the unconditional git rev-parse calls.'
findings.what_is_actually_true_now: The body and the AC attribute the same bound of 2 to two DIFFERENT and non-overlapping sets. MEASURED: hooks/stop_notifier/ contains 17 subprocess spawn sites across core.py, post_impl.py and voice.py. Exactly 2 are git rev-parse calls, both in post_impl.py at :56 and :209. Separately, the 2 scripts confirmed to exist are sync-version.py (spawned at post_impl.py via subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(sync_script)])) and voice-notifier.py (spawned via subprocess.Popen in voice.py). Those are four distinct spawn opportunities, not two. A test asserting 'at most 2' cannot be written without deciding which set the bound covers, and the issue supplies both answers.
findings.what_it_blocks: V2-033's AC2 directly. An implementer instrumenting 20 real invocations and measuring 3 or 4 cannot tell whether that is a pass with a documented exception or a failure.
findings.note: This is the same shape as V2-004's AC3: an AC that reads as rigour but cannot be evaluated as written. It is weaker than AC3's case because it is resolvable by an owner ruling rather than being self-contradictory on its face.

findings.claim_as_written: build_status: 'DESIGNED, NOT BUILT. ADR-020's layers are written in prescriptive voice throughout; the HLD states no build status for any of them. No doctor command and no commands/ directory exist on disk (verified absent 2026-08-01).'
findings.what_is_actually_true_now: Half true, and the false half is checkable in one grep. MEASURED: there is no commands/ directory anywhere in the repo -- that part holds. But a doctor command DOES exist: scripts/cli.py:209 defines cmd_doctor(args) and scripts/cli.py:340 registers it as 'cwe doctor' with help text 'Diagnose common issues'. What does not exist is a PLUGIN doctor command implementing ADR-020's DETECT layer, which is what the issue means.
findings.what_it_blocks: Nothing hard, but it cuts both ways: an implementer grepping for 'doctor' finds a live command and may conclude the DETECT layer is partly built, or may extend the engine CLI rather than building the plugin command ADR-020 specifies.
findings.what_unblocks_it: Reword to 'no PLUGIN doctor command exists; the unrelated cwe doctor at scripts/cli.py:209 is not the ADR-020 DETECT layer'.

verified_accurate.claim: 19 confirmed sites of text-mode open() lacking encoding=, corrected up from an earlier 12-count grep that missed the mode-less open(path) form. 0 absolute path literals.
verified_accurate.result: ACCURATE, INDEPENDENTLY REPRODUCED. An AST scan of langgraph_engine/, hooks/, scripts/ and src/ built by this pass -- classifying by ast.Call on the builtin open, excluding binary mode and keyword encoding -- returned exactly 19 sites. 7 of the 19 are the mode-less form (mode=None), which is precisely the class the issue warns detection tooling must catch.

discrepancy_with_brief.item: The brief states '10 of the 18 ENFORCED policies are absent from the tree get_policies_dir() actually reads.'
discrepancy_with_brief.method: Parsed the 46-row matrix in the reshaped audit file, took the 18 rows with Status ENFORCED, and tested each policy filename against the set of .md basenames found by os.walk over ~/.claude/policies.
discrepancy_with_brief.surrounding_figures_confirmed: 18 of 46 audited policies are absent from the live tree in total (9 ENFORCED, 5 PARTIAL, 2 CONTRADICTED, 1 DOCUMENTED-ONLY, 0 STALE-TOPOLOGY -- sums to 17, plus mcp-plugin-discovery-policy.md DOCUMENTED-ONLY = 18). docs/policies holds 46 .md; ~/.claude/policies holds 35 unique .md basenames. The brief's 46 / 35 figures are confirmed MEASURED.
discrepancy_with_brief.note: Reported rather than silently adopted. Three of the absent names have near-miss neighbours in the live tree that a loose matcher would count as present -- tool-optimization-policy.md versus the live tool-usage-optimization-policy.md, test-generation-policy.md versus test-case-policy.md, issue-closure-policy.md versus github-issues-integration-policy.md. A matcher doing prefix or fuzzy comparison would report 6, not 9. Exact-basename matching gives 9.

could_not_verify: The live GitHub issue bodies for #265-#293. The github-api MCP server exposes no get_issue and no list_comments tool. All findings are against docs/phase-6-sprint/github_issues.json, the recorded source the bodies were created from. If scrum-master-agent has amended that file concurrently, findings may already be addressed.

Whether the 2 rev-parse calls and the 2 surviving script spawns in hooks/stop_notifier/ actually fire on the same turn. Determining U-01's real per-turn floor requires running the Stop hook with instrumentation, which is exactly the work V2-033 exists to do. The 17-site and 2-rev-parse figures are static counts.
2 of the 18 md line citations were counted but not individually resolved, so the 8-confirmed-wrong figure for S-03 is a floor.

Whether hld.md carries the same corrections as hld_v2.md. Commit 14f742a touched both with identical line deltas (+77 each), which is consistent with them being byte-identical, but this pass verified the corrected text in hld_v2.md only.

The acceptance criteria of V2-011, V2-012 and V2-013 were read but their subject matter (a KG-driven selector that does not exist yet) offers no present-state claim to check against disk beyond the absence of the code, which was confirmed.

Whether any B-H issue's ACs are unsatisfiable for reasons other than an internal contradiction -- for example an AC requiring a measurement that cannot be taken. Only V2-033's AC2 and V2-017's build_status surfaced under the tests applied.
